findings.title: SSTI via Jinja2 Template Injection in /total_loan_payments principal parameter
findings.description: Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) in the `principal` GET parameter of the /total_loan_payments endpoint. The application builds JSON responses using Jinja2's render_template_string() with user-controlled input concatenated directly into the template string. The application applies input filters blocking `{{`, `}}`, `.`, `_`, and `[`, but these are bypassed using: (1) Jinja2 `{% if/for %}` block tags instead of `{{ }}` expressions; (2) `\x5f` escape sequences for underscores in string literals; (3) `|attr()` filter for attribute/method access without dots; (4) `|list` and `loop|attr('index0')` for character iteration without brackets. This allows full RCE via `lipsum.__globals__['os'].popen('cmd').read()`. The flag was extracted from /flag via blind boolean oracle.
